portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
The libgnomecups is a GNOME library for CUPS integration.

These updated libgnomecups packages fix a bug in which the starting time
for gnome-default-printer depended on the number of cups-registered
printers, which for large numbers of printers was very slow. This has been
fixed so that gnome-default-printer starts in a consistent amount of time
regardless of the number of cups printers.

Users are advised to upgrade to these updated libgnomecups packages, which
resolve this issue.
